messages:
nina: Heads up — CI on python-sdk failing after the latest typegen run. Tests around auth/retry are red.
omar: Which test? quick link please.
lisa: Failing test: python-sdk/tests/test_retries.py::test_retry_on_401_refresh — it expects a token refresh on 401 and a retry, but server logs show two requests with the old token.
typegen-bot: typegen detected changes: python-sdk/redwood_client/auth.py (regenerated)
ci-bot: pytest: 1 failed, other suites green
sam: Likely parity issue — we changed the auth hook signature in the generator last week to accept (req, ctx). Middleware still calls auth_hook(req).
nina: That would explain it. Quick fix idea: add a compatibility shim in the retry middleware that calls hook with ctx if argcount == 2, else falls back. Less risky than reverting generator.
omar: Agreed, do the shim and add a test. Also regen the python client and commit the generated file.
lisa: Note: publish currently blocked too — regen-diff detected the auth.py change and publish aborted because no version bump / changelog entry.
release-bot: publish aborted: missing version bump or changelog; run `poetry version patch` and include a changelog entry.
sam: So two steps: (1) code fix + regen + tests, (2) bump and changelog. I'll handle the shim PR.
nina: Please include a short `### Fixes` line in CHANGELOG.md referencing DEVEX-491 so release-drafter picks it up. CI linter is strict.
sam: Will do. Local checklist before pushing: `yarn typegen`, `pytest -k retry`, `poetry version patch`, update CHANGELOG.md, push.
lisa: Longer term: add cross-language parity tests in the typegen-suite to catch signature mismatches. Also add a regen-diff heuristic that flags parameter-count changes in critical hooks.
omar: Filed DEVEX-491 for the parity test and DEVEX-492 for regen-diff heuristics. Assign to nina and jess.
ci-bot: PR lint: changelog entry required.
sam: Pushed shim PR with tests and changelog update, bumped patch. CI now:
ci-bot: typegen run -> no unexpected diffs
ci-bot: pytest -> all tests passed
ci-bot: publish -> SUCCESS python-sdk 0.8.4 published
nina: Thanks — publishing unblocked. I'll follow up on the parity test ticket and add a short note to SDK contributing guide about auth hook compatibility. :+1:
